name: Headline Dominant
description: Type carries the surface. A short, decisive headline occupies the majority of the area, with imagery reduced to a supporting fragment or removed entirely. Built for a message that can be understood without a picture.
spacing: Tight internal leading within the headline block against generous space around it, so the type reads as one mass rather than as separate lines.
responsive_behavior: Headline reflows by line count rather than by size reduction. If the message cannot hold at the minimum legible scale the copy must be cut, never the type size.
